prior_definitions: broad: uniform over FOV cell-center quadrature; regions: Gaussian density truncated only at FOV boundary, not hard-box support; points: delta at respective center
accurate_prior_provenance: Oracle-informed experimental condition; not a source detector output
source_input_convention: Original point-sampled Gaussian injection unchanged; no renormalization across source locations. Report discrete integral variation.
generator: MatchedFieldGenerator: original discrete F, source injection, P0, Q, H, R; no positivity clipping
hold_fixed: path, footprint and all reading timestamps
initial/process/measurement underlying standard normal draws, checked at every event
inference_noise: Unchanged in both controls. Mean control has zero realized initial/process/measurement perturbations; stochastic controls sample full P0,Q,R.
metrics: Final source posterior mean/error/direction, paired changes vs matched seed, mass within .05, 95% HPD membership and final latent field MSE. No J/T or online policy comparison.
scope: One source and fixed historically source-informed path. Four declared magnitudes per factor. Test sensitivity, not identify historical simulator cause; width changes integrated injection.

factor_meaning.wind_speed: Multiply truth velocity vector, preserve direction. Inference wind unchanged.
factor_meaning.source_width: Multiply truth source_sigma, preserve peak source_rate. Integrated injection changes; no mass normalization.
factor_meaning.half_life: Multiply truth half-life (baseline 6s); decay scales both deterministic persistence and process covariance per original model.
